metas.name: Sirens
metas.description: Devon is concerned about her sister's unhealthy relationship with her new boss.

metas.name: Nine Puzzles
metas.description: Jo I-na finds her uncle murdered beside a puzzle piece but can't explain her presence. Ten years later, as a criminal profiler, she investigates murders where victims are found with similar puzzle pieces.

metas.name: Real Men
metas.description: Four old friends, Massimo, Mattia, Luigi and Riccardo, juggle relationships, careers and dating in a modern world set on giving masculinity a hard time.

metas.name: Motorheads
metas.description: A group of outsiders in a once-thriving Rust Belt town form an unlikely friendship over a mutual love of automobiles.

metas.name: Tucci in Italy
metas.description: Follow Stanley Tucci as he returns to Italy for more food-based adventures, seeking out the essence of each region and its people through the food they eat.

metas.name: Rotten Legacy
metas.description: Federico Seligman retires to recover from illness, but upon return finds his sons have changed the business direction he despises. He'll do the unimaginable to prevent them from destroying his legacy.

metas.name: Football Parents
metas.description: When it comes to their children's amateur football careers, this group of parents has no shame, no chill — and a peculiar sense of team spirit.

metas.name: Duster
metas.description: Set in the 1970s Southwest, the life of a gutsy getaway driver for a growing crime syndicate goes from awful to wildly, stupidly, dangerously awful.

metas.name: Secrets We Keep
metas.description: When her neighbor's au pair goes missing, Cecilie is compelled to personally investigate but as she uncovers the truth, her perfect world falls apart.

metas.name: American Manhunt: Osama Bin Laden
metas.description: An in-depth look at how the world mobilized to hunt down Osama bin Laden after his orchestrations of the September 11th, 2001 attacks on the United States.

metas.name: Fred & Rose West: A British Horror Story
metas.description: Recently discovered police recordings and first-person accounts tell the story of Fred and Rose West, two of the UK's most prolific murderers.

metas.name: Murder Has Two Faces
metas.description: In the shadow of a highly publicized tragedy, an eerily similar crime is overlooked. GMA's Robin Roberts shines new light on the victims largely ignored.

metas.name: Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld
metas.description: Follows the galaxy's criminal underworld. Asajj Ventress, a former assassin, flees with a new ally, while Cad Bane confronts his past when meeting an old friend turned Marshal.

metas.name: Asterix & Obelix: The Big Fight
metas.description: When the druid Getafix forgets how to prepare the magic potion, Asterix and Obelix must defend the village as Caesar plots to use a Gallic law against them.

metas.name: Suspect: The Shooting of Jean Charles de Menezes
metas.description: Police pursue suspects in failed bombing attempts. Innocent Brazilian man is misidentified as a suspect and shot dead by police. Police are found guilty in his death. Police Commissioner resigns.

metas.name: Étoile
metas.description: The dancers and artistic staff of two world-renowned ballet companies embark on an ambitious gambit to save their storied institutions by swapping their most talented stars.

metas.name: A Tragedy Foretold: Flight 3054
metas.description: The untold stories and human tragedy behind Latin America's deadliest air disaster are investigated in this three-part documentary series.

metas.name: Secrets of the Penguins
metas.description: Over two extraordinary years, National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory discovered never-before-filmed secret traditions, surprising intelligence and close-knit societies of penguins. This astonishing series reveals they are more like us than we ever dreamed, from their powerful friendships to the courageous risk-takers using ingenuity and innovation in some of the world's most extreme places.

metas.name: The Narrow Road to the Deep North
metas.description: Burma Railway in 1943 and across the Pacific during World War II, charts the cruelty of war, the tenuousness of life and the impossibility of love, as seen through the eyes of an Australian doctor and prisoner of war.

metas.name: Istanbul Encyclopedia
metas.description: A young student moves in with an estranged family friend in Istanbul, trading her humble hometown for a city that tests her identity — and convictions.

metas.name: The Diamond Heist
metas.description: In 2000, a group of London criminals plan an audacious heist: ram-raid the Millennium Dome, steal diamond and escape by boat on the Thames, but the police are surveilling them.

metas.name: Towards Zero
metas.description: Inspector Leach probes the brutal murder of an elderly widow in her Gull's Point home. A failed suicide, a false theft charge, an out-of-service hotel lift and a tennis star's love life intersect, culminating in a bizarre mass mur...

metas.name: Government Cheese
metas.description: Hampton Chambers a newly released ex-convict striving to leave his criminal history behind and reunite with his family. Amidst this struggle, he grapples with frequent inexplicable moments of divine intervention.

metas.name: Project UFO
metas.description: A smug TV host and a small-town ufologist work to uncover the origins of an alleged UFO sighting, splitting the nation in a storm of doubts and beliefs.

metas.name: The Glass Dome
metas.description: A criminologist and her former police chief partner investigate the vanishing of a local girl in the small Swedish town where she was once held captive.

metas.name: Resident Playbook
metas.description: First-year OBGYN residents at Yulje Medical Center navigate the chaos of their work and personal lives, all in their quest to become exceptional doctors.

metas.name: The Gardener
metas.description: Elmer and his controlling mother La China Jurado have a contract killing business. Emotionless after an accident, Elmer falls for Violeta, a teacher he's hired to kill. He must learn to love while his mother tries to eliminate Vio...

metas.name: Bad Influence: The Dark Side of Kidfluencing
metas.description: A revealing look into YouTube star Piper Rockelle's world, her relationship with her manager-mother Tiffany Smith, and the untold stories of past collaborators who were part of her content-creating team.

metas.name: Blippi's Job Show
metas.description: Blippi and Meekah are on a mission to learn about all kinds of jobs. From driving a monster truck to making pizzas, there's no job too big or too small!

metas.name: Lazarus
metas.description: In 2052, an emergency task force is assembled when a miracle cure is hijacked for purging populations.

metas.name: Dying for Sex
metas.description: Story of a woman diagnosed with metastatic breast cancer, who abandons her husband of 15 years and begins to fully explore her sexuality.

metas.name: Karma
metas.description: Bound by their harrowing destinies, a physician plagued by nightmares, a man shaken after his world was unexpectedly disrupted and a debtor drowning in private loans become caught in inescapable circumstances.

metas.name: The Bondsman
metas.description: Resurrected bounty hunter Hub Halloran gets an unexpected second chance at life, love and his nearly forgotten musical career--only to find that his old job now has a demonic new twist.

metas.name: Pulse
metas.description: Follows the personal and professional lives of doctors and staff at a busy Miami trauma center.

metas.name: Mid-Century Modern
metas.description: After an unexpected death, three best friends--gay gentlemen of a certain age--decide to spend their golden years living together in Palm Springs, where the wealthiest one lives with his mother.

metas.name: Gold & Greed: The Hunt for Fenn's Treasure
metas.description: An eccentric man named Forrest Fenn sets off a real-life treasure hunt when he hides a chest of gold in the Rockies — and leaves clues in a cryptic poem.

metas.name: Caught
metas.description: In Bariloche, reporter Ema Garay's online exposes unveil tax dodgers. Her probe into a 16-year-old's disappearance points to Leo Mercer, upending both their lives.

metas.name: Side Quest
metas.description: The lives of the employees, players, and fans who are affected by the video game Mythic Quest (2020).

metas.name: David Blaine: Do Not Attempt
metas.description: Magician David Blaine travels globally, connecting with masters and performers who share unique skills and secrets. His journey spans Brazil, Southeast Asia, India, the Arctic, South Africa and Japan.

metas.name: The Residence
metas.description: Inside the White House's staff residence and the lives which workers share with the First Family.

metas.name: Dope Thief
metas.description: Follows long-time friends and delinquents who pose as DEA agents to rob a house in the countryside, but end up unintentionally revealing and unraveling the biggest hidden narcotics corridor on the Eastern seaboard.

metas.name: Adolescence
metas.description: When a 13-year-old is accused of the murder of a classmate, his family, therapist and the detective in charge are all left asking what really happened.

metas.name: Long Bright River
metas.description: A Philadelphia police officer searches for her sister, an addict who has gone missing.

metas.name: The Leopard
metas.description: A 19th-century Sicilian aristocratic family gets caught up in the changing sociopolitical times.

metas.name: Just One Look
metas.description: Greta's life unravels when an old photo shows her husband and others, one with a crossed-out face. Greta searches for him, realizing he's been kidnapped while her kids are threatened. The truth leads back to Greta's past trauma.

metas.name: Medusa
metas.description: Somebody wants to kill CEO Bárbara Hidalgo. Can she find the culprit as her family schemes ruthlessly for control of their Colombian business empire?

metas.name: Nine Bodies in a Mexican Morgue
metas.description: A plane carrying ten people crashes into the Mexican jungle, leaving them stranded. As they are murdered one by one, the remaining survivors must solve the mystery of who is killing them.

metas.name: Dabba Cartel
metas.description: In VivaLife Society, men and women lead parallel lives - one caught in a pharma investigation, the other in drug peddling through a dabba delivery business.

metas.name: Doubters to Believers - Liverpool FC: Klopp's Era
metas.description: Midway through the 2023/24 season, Jürgen Klopp stuns Liverpool fans by announcing his departure. This series charts his final season and nine year tenure, showing how he turned doubters into believers and led the club to glory.

metas.name: Toxic Town
metas.description: When dozens of babies in Corby are born with disabilities, their mothers embark on a battle to hold those responsible to account.

metas.name: Devil in the Family: The Fall of Ruby Franke
metas.description: Follows Ruby Franke, a former YouTube mom blogger with millions of followers who was sentenced to prison for child abuse.

metas.name: Su majestad
metas.description: Pilar, Princess of Spain and future queen of the country, is a troubled free-spirited party lover who is asked to save Spain of a possible scandal which affects to her family and it could ruin the royal institution.

metas.name: Berlin ER
metas.description: After her private life falls apart, a young doctor seeking a fresh start takes over the emergency room in Berlin's toughest, most chaotic hospital. Battling staff resistance and a run-down system, she must unite her maverick team to save lives.

metas.name: Grosse Pointe Garden Society
metas.description: Four members of a suburban garden club get caught up in murder and mischief as they strive to flourish.

metas.name: Zero Day
metas.description: In the midst of crisis, how can we discover the truth when it seems the world is being destroyed by uncontrollable forces? And to what extent are conspiracy theories our own inventions or products of our imagination?

metas.name: How I Escaped My Cult
metas.description: Go inside insidious modern-day cults through the unique lens of members who endured unspeakable trauma and the shocking investigations into these oppressive groups. With detailed, firsthand accounts from former cult members, their loved ones, and the investigators who helped bring these tormentors to justice.

metas.name: Win or Lose
metas.description: Follows a middle school softball team in the week leading up to their championship game, and each episode is told from the perspective of a different character.

metas.name: Good Cop/Bad Cop
metas.description: Siblings working as detectives in a small town navigate quirky locals, limited resources, their strained relationship, and their father, who's the police chief, in this comedic crime procedural.

metas.name: My Family
metas.description: A terminally ill father prepares his chaotic family to care for his two young kids and face life without him — but they must put old quarrels to rest.

metas.name: The Fox Hollow Murders: Playground of a Serial Killer
metas.description: Hamilton County coroner Jeff Jellison launches a new investigation into Herb Baumeister decades after thousands of bones were found in the woods behind Fox Hollow Farms, Baumeister's stately home. Using new DNA technology, Jellison and his team work to identify the human remains, bringing long-deferred closure to victims' families and unearthing unsettling questions about potential accomplices, mi

metas.name: Apple Cider Vinegar
metas.description: The life of wellness guru Belle Gibson, who had a large social media following, where she pretended to be suffering from cancer but keeping the disease under control using self-care therapies. She confessed that none of it was true.

metas.name: Cassandra
metas.description: Germany's oldest smart home awakens its AI helper Cassandra after decades when a new family moves in. Cassandra, determined never to be abandoned again, manipulates events using the home's resources to become part of the family.

metas.name: Prison Cell 211
metas.description: Follows a riot that took place at a state prison in the Mexican border town of Ciudad Juárez on Dec 31, 2022 that left several dead.

metas.name: Love You to Death
metas.description: Raúl's world is unraveling. Marta's unexpectedly pregnant. After a funeral meet-cute brings them together, they stumble through the chaos of life and love.

metas.name: The Best Heart Attack of My Life
metas.description: A ghostwriter's life-threatening heart attack in a foreign country forces him to rely on strangers for help. This unexpected crisis becomes a transformative experience, reshaping his perspective and impacting those around him.

metas.name: Shared Custody
metas.description: Follows Cris and Diego, who have just separated and are both forced to move back into their parents' houses, but things quickly deteriorate as once divided lives become intertwined again.

metas.name: Shafted
metas.description: Follow Cédric, Tom, Jérémie and Tonio, four friends whose romantic and professional lives are turned upside down by the women in their lives.

metas.name: Prime Target
metas.description: A post-graduate mathematics student discovers an effort being made to destroy his work in finding a pattern in prime numbers that would allow him to access every computer in the world.

metas.name: Out There
metas.description: A farmer is confronted with dark forces seeping into his rural community, leading to an investigation into the county lines drug cartel.

metas.name: Lovers Anonymous
metas.description: Cem, scarred by a childhood that crushed his trust in love, runs the "Love Hospital" — until Hazal, a believer in the power of love, disrupts his life.

metas.name: Public Disorder
metas.description: An incident sparks internal conflict as members of a riot squad juggle personal worries with the daily tension of police work on the streets.

metas.name: Unmasked
metas.description: In modern-day Seoul, a crack team of investigative journalists fight for their careers after broadcasting a controversial story. With time running out, the team are given an impossible task if they want to save their jobs – solve a twenty-year-old cold case involving a famous actor who disappeared without a trace.

metas.name: Black Warrant
metas.description: A newly appointed jailer at Tihar Prison confronts widespread corruption and injustice within its walls, forcing him to choose between maintaining the status quo or fighting for reform.

metas.name: American Primeval
metas.description: It follows the gritty and adventurous exploration of the birth of the American West, the violent collisions of cults, religion, and men and women fighting for control of the new world.

metas.name: On Call
metas.description: A rookie and a veteran officer patrol duo in Long Beach, California, face the morality of protecting and serving a community.

metas.name: Asura
metas.description: Four sisters face turbulence when their father's affair is exposed. Embodying the tumultuous "asura" demigods, they clash over differing outlooks on love yet find moments of connection amid conflict and growth.

metas.name: I Am Ilary
metas.description: Follow TV host Ilary Blasi as she defines her life post-divorce, balancing personal growth, career opportunities and a new love.

metas.name: Hound's Hill
metas.description: Famous writer Mikolaj returns to hometown facing blackmail over a book about a past murder. His activist father opposes local corruption. Mikolaj's journalist wife investigates, uncovering dark secrets tied to the town's tragic hi...

metas.name: Jerry Springer: Fights, Camera, Action
metas.description: Jaw-dropping documentary goes behind the scenes of America's most controversial talk show to expose its biggest scandals, both on- and off-camera.

metas.name: The Breakthrough
metas.description: When the double murder in Linköping, Sweden, back in 2004 was finally solved after 16 years, it was a genealogist who made the breakthrough. For the first time in Europe, a murder could be solved through genealogical research.

metas.name: When the Stars Gossip
metas.description: A space station romantic comedy between space tourists and astronauts.

metas.name: Lockerbie: A Search for Truth
metas.description: Pan Am Flight 103 explodes over Lockerbie in 1988, killing 259 on board and 11 on the ground. Dr. Jim Swire seeks justice for his daughter Flora, a passenger on the plane.

metas.name: Missing You
metas.description: Detective Kat Donovan's world unravels when she finds her estranged fiancé on a dating app. Leading her to reopen her father's unsolved murder.

metas.name: Mafia
metas.description: The stark transformation of 1990s Sweden from peaceful to perilous as it follows the ascent of Radovan "Jakov" Jakovic from rags to criminal riches and Gunn Philak, the lone cop who sees the looming mafia menace in cigarette smuggling's shadow.

metas.name: Cunk on Cinema
metas.description: Philomena Cunk explores the history of film, from early cameras and 1960s New Wave to CGI and artificial intelligence.

metas.name: El crimen de Pazos
metas.description: In a quiet town, Aniceto and wife Irene seem perfect until she's brutally attacked during an alleged robbery. As she fights for life, Civil Guard Elías believes Aniceto's guilty but faces system resistance.
